end.summary:
Dev practised how tree roots hold soil and reduce soil being washed away by rain.
Dev practised ways people can protect plants and birds: planting, watering, preventing trampling, and keeping water for birds.
Dev practised the meaning of a sacred grove, including villagers protecting a forest area and its living things.
The idea that only government can protect nature appeared again and was not corrected after its last mention; revisit next time.
The link between protecting trees and providing homes for birds was practised and needs another check.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of how everyday people can care for plants, birds, water and soil. Dev gave useful examples such as watering new plants, preventing trampling, planting trees and leaving water for birds; they also described a sacred grove. Dev again mixed up who can protect nature, saying only the government can help, and this was not corrected after the last mention. At home, ask Dev to name two actions people can take to protect one local plant or animal and explain how each helps.
